articles.title: Handling Failed Upgrades & Multiple Pending Bank Charges
articles.content: When payment gateway experiences authorization timeouts, card issuers may show multiple pending holds without actual settlement. These pending charges typically drop off within 3-5 business days. If a customer is charged 2+ times, Tier-2 Billing must immediately: 1. Confirm gateway settlement status in Stripe dashboard. 2. Provision emergency 7-day Pro access if user has urgent deadline. 3. Void uncaptured authorizations or process manual refunds. Never leave high-sentiment or dispute-threatened customers without human escalation.

articles.title: Service Outage (HTTP 500) & Regional Edge Gateway Diagnostics
articles.content: Public status pages may lag behind real-time incidents by 15-30 minutes. If an Enterprise customer reports HTTP 500 across multiple browsers and coworkers, escalate immediately to Tier-3 / On-call SRE. Potential cause: Regional edge POP degradation (e.g., Cloudflare AP-Southeast node routing failures). SLA requires response within 15 minutes for 40+ seat enterprise accounts.

articles.title: Dark Mode Troubleshooting and Feature Compatibility
articles.content: On macOS with Electron desktop app v4.2+, 'System Default' mode may fail to detect macOS Sonoma dark mode if Hardware Acceleration is disabled. Workaround: Toggle Settings > Appearance > Hardware Acceleration > Restart App. Feature Request Note: Scheduled dark mode (time-based switching) is not yet supported and should be logged as a customer feature request in Jira.
